confirmed_rejection_reasons.observation: Actual back-left image shows the near anatomical LEFT arm gripping the extended axe and the far RIGHT arm empty. The forward reach cannot be adopted because it reverses the boss weapon hand. Geometry passes, visual identity fails.
Strict importer rejects a pose rectangle including an adjacent body. The good opposite-support anatomy is preserved but cannot be safely bound as complete independent source regions.

The final rightmost figure reaches the image right edge at its empty claw; two alpha>100 pixels touch that boundary. Strict importer rejects the source as potentially truncated. No padding, guard relaxation or clipped adoption is used.

unreviewed_details_not_additional_gates: No new native timeline or runtime frames were created because the specific source failures were established first.
Further timing or detailed secondary motion review was not needed to decide these rejections.
decision: Retain verified r003 and its E/S/NW improvements. Preserve all actual new art and exact requests as HOLD. Stop at the authorized three targeted calls rather than counting unsafe or wrong-hand art as a repair.
